links.outcome: Medical Q&A accuracy of retrieval-grounded multi-round agentic RAG versus backbone and RAG baselines
links.effect: MA-RAG consistently surpassed inference-time scaling and RAG baselines across 7 medical Q&A benchmarks, with +6.8 points average accuracy over the backbone model.
links.quote: Extensive evaluations across 7 medical Q&A benchmarks show that MA-RAG consistently surpasses competitive inference-time scaling and RAG baselines, delivering substantial +6.8 points on average accuracy over the backbone model.

unlisted_practices: Multi-round agentic refinement that turns semantic conflict among candidate responses into retrieval queries (self-consistency-based test-time scaling)

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an agentic retrieval-augmented generation framework (MA-RAG) on medical Q&A benchmarks to mitigate hallucinations and improve reasoning accuracy, but focuses purely on benchmark performance of a new system architecture rather than organizational deployment safeguards.
